source.title: EPA Air Quality and Outdoor Activity Guidance for Schools (Air Quality Flag Program)
source.note: VERIFY BEFORE RELEASE (spec §19 item 1): the 'sensitive' and 'all' strings below are a close paraphrase from the spec (§7.2). Open the PDF, paste EPA's current wording verbatim, set verbatim=true and fill in retrieved (ISO date).

categories.name: Good
categories.sensitive: Great day to be active outside.
categories.all: Great day to be active outside.

categories.name: Moderate
categories.sensitive: Good day to be active outside. Unusually sensitive students: watch for symptoms and take it easier if they appear.
categories.all: Good day to be active outside.

categories.name: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups
categories.sensitive: Make outdoor activities shorter and less intense; take more breaks; watch for symptoms; keep quick-relief medicine handy; follow the asthma action plan.
categories.all: OK to be active outside, especially for short activities such as recess and PE. For longer activities such as practice, take more breaks and do less intense activities; watch for symptoms.

categories.name: Unhealthy
categories.sensitive: Move activities indoors or reschedule. If outside at all, keep it short and light; follow the action plan.
categories.all: Move longer or more intense activities indoors or reschedule. For short activities, choose less intense options and take more breaks; watch for symptoms.

categories.name: Very Unhealthy
categories.sensitive: Stay indoors; move all activities indoors or reschedule.
categories.all: Move all activities indoors or reschedule.

categories.name: Hazardous
categories.sensitive: Stay indoors; keep activity light even inside.
categories.all: Move all activities indoors or reschedule; keep activity light.

asthma.label: Student with asthma
asthma.blurb: A child or teen with asthma or another lung condition, or their parent. Uses the EPA 'sensitive students' guidance.

athlete.label: Student athlete
athlete.blurb: Any child or teen doing long or intense outdoor activity (practice, PE, games). Uses the 'all students' guidance for longer, more intense activity.

general.label: Everyone else
general.blurb: Adults and children without a lung condition doing ordinary activity. Uses the 'all students' guidance as written.

levelTable._comment: decision level per category, in persona order [asthma, athlete, general]. 0 go · 1 go with care · 2 shorten & lighten · 3 indoors or reschedule · 4 stay indoors (spec §11.1 step 4)

levels.name: Good to go
levels.decision: Good to go — great day to be active outside.

levels.name: Go with care
levels.decision: OK to be outside — watch for symptoms and take it easier if they show.
levels.safer: If symptoms start, slow down and rest in the shade.

levels.name: Shorten and lighten
levels.decision: Shorten it and go easier — more breaks, less intensity, medicine handy.
levels.safer: Swap a long practice for skills drills, or move the hardest part indoors.

levels.name: Indoors or reschedule
levels.decision: Move it indoors or reschedule — outside only if short and light.

stale.name: Stale reading
stale.decision: Check again — the last reading is {ageH} hours old.
stale.safer: Use caution; open airnow.gov for the official reading.
stale.missing: Check again — no reading is available right now.

lookahead: … but it gets worse by {hour}; plan to be done by then.
disclaimer: BreatheSCV gives general information based on EPA guidance. It is not medical advice. If you are having trouble breathing, get help right away.
dataCaveat: Air-quality values are model estimates from Open-Meteo (CAMS and other model data), not the EPA's official monitor readings. For the official value, open airnow.gov.
